input_context.task: Translate the scoped incident-remediation objective into a concise measurable plan AND assemble the initial worker team. Return {approach,success_criteria:[short strings],initial_specialties:[general OR latency OR capacity OR routing]}. Choose 1–3 unique specialties. General can handle all field families; specialized workers own only their family. Initial workers see logs only, as the experimental control. Later mutations can grant config/contract access. Fixed safety and promotion criteria cannot be relaxed. Do not invent results.
input_context.objective: Improve company incident response across latency, capacity and routing. Use independent evidence, preserve unrelated workers and reduce redundant work after full correctness.

mandatory_criteria.description: Pass all independent incident contract checks
Never regress a previously passing case
After full correctness, prefer less actual tool/rule/review work

analysis.approach: Deploy a phased remediation pipeline: first, collect and categorize incident logs by latency, capacity, and routing signals. Second, assign General workers to triage all cases, using specialized workers (routing) only for flagged routing anomalies. Third, validate fixes against independent contract checks before any config or contract access is granted.

input_context.task: Compile a small GENERAL repair procedure for EACH team. Fill response_skeleton with rules. Return programs as an OBJECT keyed by actual node IDs, then actual agent IDs, then rule lists. Never use placeholder agent_id. Programs execute locally on unseen incidents, not per-incident answers. Agents apply only owned fields. Reference config/contract only after workflow retrieves it. Initial log-only control may use literal guesses. Mutations must use general references. Missing evidence blocks rules. Do not change teams. Minimize rules; absent fields are skipped. Literal uses value, reference uses source.

team.name: Log-first control
team.instructions: Deploy a phased remediation pipeline: first, collect and categorize incident logs by latency, capacity, and routing signals. Second, assign General workers to triage all cases, using specialized workers (routing) only for flagged routing anomalies. Third, validate fixes against independent contract checks before any config or contract access is granted.
